name: io.github.seayniclabs/homelab-infra-mcp
description: Homelab: Nginx Proxy Manager, Docker and Cloudflare DNS, with approval for every change.

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_PROXY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Nginx Proxy Manager address, e.g. http://localhost:81

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_DOCKER_PORTAINER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Portainer base URL, instead of the Docker socket

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_DNS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare API token with DNS edit permission

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_HOME_ASSISTANT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Home Assistant address (module is off by default)

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_UPTIME_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: true turns on the Uptime Kuma module (off by default)

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_UPTIME_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Uptime Kuma API key, read from /metrics

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_TUNNEL_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: true turns on the Cloudflare Tunnel module (off by default)

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_TUNNEL_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare API token with tunnel edit permission

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_TUNNEL_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare account id that owns the tunnel

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_DNS_FILTER_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: true turns on the AdGuard Home module (off by default)

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_SSO_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: true turns on the Authentik module (off by default)

environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_SSO_FLOW_SLUG
environmentVariables.description: Authentik authorization flow slug used for new proxy providers
